info.title: The Better Plate API
info.description: Versioned REST API for The Better Plate. Authentication uses session cookies issued by /v1/auth (email one-time code: POST /v1/auth/email-otp/send-verification-otp, then POST /v1/auth/sign-in/email-otp). Nutrition values are estimates computed from USDA FoodData Central records; not-reported nutrients are never zero.

nutrientsPer100g.description: Per 100 g as published. A missing key means not reported, never zero.
